blocks.text: Michelle Dee revealed she was rushed to the hospital and underwent an emergency appendectomy after suffering from severe abdominal discomfort. The actress-beauty queen spoke about her medical ordeal during a livestream on her TikTok page on Monday, Nov. 9. Dee was reportedly heading to a photoshoot when she experienced severe abdominal pain. She was then rushed to the hospital and underwent a CT scan, which showed stones obstructing her appendix. In a separate post on her Instagram Stories, Dee showed herself lying in a hospital bed but still flashing a smile. “CT scan to surgery real quick,” she captioned the photo. […]...
